name: event-driven-architecture
description: Design messaging across service and process boundaries - when to go async, how events propagate between contexts, reliable publication (outbox/inbox, dual-write), delivery semantics (at-least-once, idempotent consumers, DLQ, ordering), and event/schema versioning. Use when work crosses a service boundary with queues, brokers, or streams (Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS), integration events, or an evolving event schema.
